paras: NB: I am NOT saying to use these. But a lot of people try these for the first time while under the influence.
Also if you DO use these, remember that you don't want to force it in that state, but help you in your regular life.

Also if you HAVE used these in the past and opened something, remember that it is different to have it in that state, then to have it in your regular life. It is great that it opened, but if the child isn't able to take it in, rather than turning the tap on more, you want to say things like: "Help me to ground". "Help me to only take that which I can take in". "Help me to remember love". "Help me to come back when the time is right". "Help me to take one change into my regular life".

Don't use self hypnosis to: Keep you in that state forever Make memories come up Make you afraid to do things Make you not sleep Do anything that your body needs you not to Do Make you not talk to people

If you are doing any of these, while you are in the altered state of consciousness and it is helping you NOT to love/ground/be honest/sleep/talk/regular life, then you need to stop trying to get to the next level and work on incorporating what you have into your life.

Self hypnosis is powerful. Especially if you are in an altered state of consciousness through loveyhuasca/meditation/lucid dreaming/grief/sexual energy/prayer/not sleeping/insert any other thing that is similar to plant medicine here. Often your mind opens faster then your adult can figure out what is going on.

The problem is that you THINK that because you are in an altered state of consciousness that what is going on MEANS something. Sometimes it IS your inner child talking, but just as often it is a Protector showing you what they are afraid of, or it is your shame, or it is your grief, or it is your anger, or it is your longing, or it is something else in you that wants to be taken care of, or it is just your body's reaction to being over loaded, or it is the chaos in your environment, or it is your lack of sleep, or it is just you being confused. Just because you had a picture that scared you doesn't mean it is true. Just because you had a bad feeling doesn't mean it is something you need to learn. Just because you had a download in nice lighting doesn't mean you should believe it.
Before you try to interpret it, what do you need to do first?
